Container.Name: homelab-monitor
Container.Overview: Homelab monitoring in one container. The bit I actually built it for: per-container GPU/VRAM attribution - it tells you which container is holding the card, not just total GPU load. On top of that: Docker container health, systemd service status, host vitals (CPU/RAM/disk/temps), and several machines over SSH in one view. Alerts via Discord, ntfy and Telegram. A read-only MCP server (port 9810) lets AI agents query the homelab directly. MIT licensed.
Container.Changes: [2026-07-06] - Docker socket now mounted read-write by default: self-update and the Containers/Services tabs' start/stop/restart controls are on by default (set ALLOW_SELF_UPDATE=0 / ENABLE_CONTROLS=0 to turn either off). [2026-06-27] - Initial Unraid Community Applications template for HomeLab Monitor v0.21.0

Config.Name: MCP Server Port
Config.Description: MCP server port for AI agent integration (optional — only expose if you use Claude/AI tools)

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent storage for historical metrics and settings

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Docker socket — powers container health/resource usage, one-click self-update, and the Containers tab's start/stop/restart/restart-policy controls (all on by default; set ALLOW_SELF_UPDATE=0 and ENABLE_CONTROLS=0 as extra Variables below if you'd rather keep this read-only)

Config.Name: SAMPLE_INTERVAL_SECONDS
Config.Description: How often to poll metrics (seconds). 5-60 is sensible.

Config.Name: HISTORY_DAYS
Config.Description: Days of metric history to keep in SQLite.
